obligations.sourceLabel: Retsinformation, LBK nr 1462 af 18/11/2025 (lov om betalingskonti og basale erhvervskonti, consolidated), §§ 1 a and 13 c, inserted by LOV nr 1666 af 30/12/2024, § 1, in force 1 January 2025

titles.en: Offer businesses and associations with Danish ties a basic business account

summaries.en: A bank designated as a systemically important financial institution (SIFI) or part of a SIFI group, and certain branches of foreign credit institutions in such groups, must offer a basic business account in Danish kroner to businesses and associations that meet the Act's conditions of Danish residence, such as a Danish registered office and a director or beneficial owner resident in Denmark.

instruments.title: Add Ledelsesbekendtgørelsen, BEK nr 1103 af 30/06/2022
instruments.sourceLabel: Retsinformation, BEK nr 1103 af 30/06/2022, issued by Finanstilsynet, § 27 on entry into force

titles.da: Bekendtgørelse om ledelse og styring af pengeinstitutter m.fl.
titles.en: Executive Order on management and control of banks etc.

payload.implementsNote: Parts of CRD, Directive 2013/36/EU, as amended by Directives (EU) 2019/878 and 2024/1619

obligations.title: Add the duty: Have the board decide the business model and policies and assess the firm's risks at least every second year
obligations.sourceLabel: Retsinformation, BEK nr 1103 af 30/06/2022 (ledelsesbekendtgørelsen), § 3, stk. 1, as amended by BEK nr 1335 af 14/11/2025, § 1, nr. 3-4

titles.en: Have the board decide the business model and policies and assess the firm's risks at least every second year

summaries.en: The board must decide the business model and, on that basis, the firm's policies, assess at least every second year the firm's individual and overall risks and whether they are acceptable, and decide on budgets, capital, liquidity, material transactions and special risks. Since 1 January 2026 it must also ensure robust strategies, policies, procedures and systems for identifying, measuring, managing and monitoring ESG risks over the short, medium and long term, with a horizon of at least ten years.

obligations.title: Add the duty: Adopt written policies for each relevant risk area
obligations.sourceLabel: Retsinformation, BEK nr 1103 af 30/06/2022 (ledelsesbekendtgørelsen), § 4, as amended by BEK nr 31 af 15/01/2025 and BEK nr 1335 af 14/11/2025

titles.en: Adopt written policies for each relevant risk area

summaries.en: The firm's policies must set its overall strategic objectives for each risk area, define which risks it is willing to take and how the objectives are achieved and, where relevant, include a credit policy, a market risk policy, an operational risk policy, a policy on insurance cover of risks and a liquidity policy with a contingency plan, as described in the annexes. Since 1 January 2026 the policies must also give guidelines on risks from current and short, medium and long-term ESG impacts.

obligations.title: Add the duty: Maintain a risk management function and a chief risk officer with direct access to the board
obligations.sourceLabel: Retsinformation, BEK nr 1103 af 30/06/2022 (ledelsesbekendtgørelsen), § 16

titles.en: Maintain a risk management function and a chief risk officer with direct access to the board

summaries.en: The executive board must ensure the firm has a risk management function and a chief risk officer (Annex 7) who can report directly to the board independently of the executive board and warn it of risk developments. Dismissing the chief risk officer requires the board's prior approval, and the executive board follows up on the officer's conclusions and recommendations.

obligations.title: Add the duty: Maintain an independent compliance function whose head can be dismissed only with board approval
obligations.sourceLabel: Retsinformation, BEK nr 1103 af 30/06/2022 (ledelsesbekendtgørelsen), § 17, as amended by BEK nr 854 af 25/06/2024, § 1, nr. 17

titles.en: Maintain an independent compliance function whose head can be dismissed only with board approval

summaries.en: The firm must have methods and procedures to detect and reduce the risk of not complying with the law, market standards and internal rules, and an independent compliance function that checks and assesses whether these and any remedial measures are effective. Since 1 July 2024 dismissing the compliance officer requires the board's prior approval.

obligations.title: Add the duty: Set guidelines for developing and approving new products and services
obligations.sourceLabel: Retsinformation, BEK nr 1103 af 30/06/2022 (ledelsesbekendtgørelsen), § 22

titles.en: Set guidelines for developing and approving new products and services

summaries.en: The executive board must ensure guidelines for developing and approving new products and services, and changes to existing ones that materially change their risk profile, which at least define when a product or service counts as new.

instruments.title: Add Solvensbehovsbekendtgørelsen, BEK nr 677 af 12/06/2025
instruments.sourceLabel: Retsinformation, BEK nr 677 af 12/06/2025, issued by Finanstilsynet, § 15 on entry into force

titles.da: Bekendtgørelse om opgørelse af risikoeksponeringer, kapitalgrundlag og solvensbehov
titles.en: Executive Order on the calculation of risk exposures, own funds and solvency need

payload.implementsNote: Parts of CRD, Directive 2013/36/EU, as amended by Directives (EU) 2019/878 and 2024/1619

obligations.title: Add the duty: Determine adequate own funds and the solvency need taking the prescribed factors into account
obligations.sourceLabel: Retsinformation, BEK nr 677 af 12/06/2025, issued by Finanstilsynet, § 3

titles.en: Determine adequate own funds and the solvency need taking the prescribed factors into account

summaries.en: When determining adequate own funds and the individual solvency need, the board and executive board must take account of the matters in Annex 1. The solvency need is expressed as adequate own funds in per cent of the total risk exposure, and the part relating to excessive leverage in per cent of the total non-risk-weighted exposure.

obligations.title: Add the duty: Publish information on adequate own funds and solvency need, half-yearly for large banks
obligations.sourceLabel: Retsinformation, BEK nr 677 af 12/06/2025, issued by Finanstilsynet, §§ 4, 5 and 6

titles.en: Publish information on adequate own funds and solvency need, half-yearly for large banks

summaries.en: Banks and mortgage-credit institutions must publish the information in Annex 2: point 1 at least once a year, and points 2 to 6 half-yearly for large institutions as defined in Article 4(1)(146) of the CRR and yearly for other banks. Significant changes must be published immediately, and publication may be delayed only where it would harm legitimate interests without misleading the public.

instruments.title: Add Regnskabsbekendtgørelsen, BEK nr 658 af 23/05/2025
instruments.sourceLabel: Retsinformation, BEK nr 658 af 23/05/2025, issued by Finanstilsynet, § 181 on entry into force

titles.da: Bekendtgørelse om finansielle rapporter for kreditinstitutter og fondsmæglerselskaber m.fl.
titles.en: Executive Order on financial reports for credit institutions and investment firms etc.

payload.implementsNote: Bank Accounts Directive 86/635/EEC; Accounting Directive 2013/34/EU; CSRD, Directive (EU) 2022/2464

obligations.title: Add the duty: Prepare and publish an annual report and a half-year report in Danish or English
obligations.sourceLabel: Retsinformation, BEK nr 658 af 23/05/2025, issued by Finanstilsynet, §§ 1-2

titles.en: Prepare and publish an annual report and a half-year report in Danish or English

summaries.en: Banks, mortgage-credit institutions, investment firms, management companies and the other firms covered must prepare and publish an annual report and a half-year report for each financial year under the Executive Order, including consolidated accounts where it requires them. Both reports must be written in Danish or English.

instruments.title: Add Bekendtgørelse om genopretningsplaner, BEK nr 536 af 11/06/2026
instruments.sourceLabel: Retsinformation, BEK nr 536 af 11/06/2026, issued by Finanstilsynet, § 13 on entry into force

titles.da: Bekendtgørelse om genopretningsplaner for pengeinstitutter, realkreditinstitutter, et skibsfinansieringsinstitut og fondsmæglerselskaber
titles.en: Executive Order on recovery plans for banks, mortgage-credit institutions, a ship finance institution and investment firms

payload.implementsNote: BRRD, Directive 2014/59/EU

obligations.title: Add the duty: Set, monitor and yearly review recovery plan indicators
obligations.sourceLabel: Retsinformation, BEK nr 536 af 11/06/2026, issued by Finanstilsynet, §§ 5, 7, 8 and 9

titles.en: Set, monitor and yearly review recovery plan indicators

summaries.en: The firm must set in its recovery plan quantitative and qualitative indicators marking when it must decide whether to take recovery actions, suited to its size, business model, strategy and risk profile. It monitors them regularly, reviews at least once a year whether they should change, and must be able to explain to the Danish FSA how they are set and why they are effective.

obligations.title: Add the duty: Report a breached recovery indicator to management within a business day and to the FSA the next
obligations.sourceLabel: Retsinformation, BEK nr 536 af 11/06/2026, issued by Finanstilsynet, § 6

titles.en: Report a breached recovery indicator to management within a business day and to the FSA the next

summaries.en: When a recovery indicator is breached, the firm must inform its management within one business day and notify the Danish FSA no later than one further business day after that internal notice.

obligations.title: Add the duty: Tell the FSA without delay when the board decides whether to activate recovery actions
obligations.sourceLabel: Retsinformation, BEK nr 536 af 11/06/2026, issued by Finanstilsynet, § 10

titles.en: Tell the FSA without delay when the board decides whether to activate recovery actions

summaries.en: The firm must notify the Danish FSA without undue delay if its board decides to take recovery actions under the recovery plan, or decides not to take them.

obligations.title: Add the duty: Submit the recovery plan to the FSA by the deadline for the firm's category
obligations.sourceLabel: Retsinformation, BEK nr 536 af 11/06/2026, issued by Finanstilsynet, §§ 2 and 11

titles.en: Submit the recovery plan to the FSA by the deadline for the firm's category

summaries.en: Systemically important institutions submit their recovery plan every year by 1 October and other banks and mortgage-credit institutions covered by § 2(2) by 1 November, while banks allowed simplified plans submit by 1 November 2028 and then every third year, and banks with a balance sheet of DKK 2 billion or less submit when they update the plan. Plans must also be updated and resubmitted after material changes, and the FSA may require more frequent submission.

instruments.title: Add Bekendtgørelse om hvidvaskindberetning, BEK nr 1062 af 17/09/2024
instruments.sourceLabel: Retsinformation, BEK nr 1062 af 17/09/2024, issued by Finanstilsynet, § 4 on entry into force

titles.da: Bekendtgørelse om indberetning af oplysninger til brug for Finanstilsynets risikovurdering af virksomheder og personer omfattet af hvidvaskloven
titles.en: Executive Order on reporting information for Finanstilsynet's risk assessment of undertakings and persons covered by the Anti-Money Laundering Act

obligations.title: Add the duty: Report AML risk data to the Danish FSA every quarter
obligations.sourceLabel: Retsinformation, BEK nr 1062 af 17/09/2024, issued by Finanstilsynet, §§ 1 and 2

titles.en: Report AML risk data to the Danish FSA every quarter

summaries.en: Banks, mortgage-credit institutions and the other firms listed in § 1(1), which refers to hvidvaskloven § 1(1)(1, 2, 5, 6, 11, 12, 18 and 22), must report the specified information to the Danish FSA for its money laundering risk assessment every quarter, by 11 February, 12 May, 11 August and 11 November. Reports are filed electronically on the form on the FSA's website.

instruments.title: Add Bekendtgørelse om grundkursus for bestyrelsesmedlemmer, BEK nr 1366 af 01/12/2024
instruments.sourceLabel: Retsinformation, BEK nr 1366 af 01/12/2024, issued by Finanstilsynet, § 13 on entry into force

titles.da: Bekendtgørelse om grundkursus for medlemmer af bestyrelsen i pengeinstitutter, realkreditinstitutter og forsikringsselskaber
titles.en: Executive Order on the basic course for board members of banks, mortgage-credit institutions and insurance undertakings

obligations.title: Add the duty: Complete a basic course covering the prescribed competence areas and prove it on request
obligations.sourceLabel: Retsinformation, BEK nr 1366 af 01/12/2024, issued by Finanstilsynet, §§ 1, 2 and 4

titles.en: Complete a basic course covering the prescribed competence areas and prove it on request

summaries.en: A person joining the board of a bank or mortgage-credit institution on or after 1 January 2025 must complete, within 12 months, a basic course covering the competence areas listed in § 2, among them the framework for the board's work, operational risk, AML, IT and cyber security, ESG, financial reporting and audit, credit, market risk, capital and buffer requirements, liquidity and the supervisory diamond. The board member must send a copy of the course certificate to the Danish FSA on request.

instruments.title: Add Bekendtgørelse om statistik over misbrug af betalingstjenester, BEK nr 1259 af 28/11/2019
instruments.sourceLabel: Retsinformation, BEK nr 1259 af 28/11/2019, issued by Finanstilsynet, § 5 on entry into force

titles.da: Bekendtgørelse om udbydere af betalingstjenesters indberetning af statistik om drift og misbrug af betalingstjenester
titles.en: Executive Order on payment service providers' reporting of statistics on the operation and misuse of payment services

payload.shortName: Bekendtgørelse om statistik over misbrug af betalingstjenester
payload.implementsNote: PSD2, Directive (EU) 2015/2366

obligations.title: Add the duty: Report payment fraud and operation statistics to the FSA every half year
obligations.sourceLabel: Retsinformation, BEK nr 1259 af 28/11/2019, issued by Finanstilsynet, §§ 1 and 2

titles.en: Report payment fraud and operation statistics to the FSA every half year

summaries.en: Banks, e-money institutions, payment institutions and certain branches that provide payment services must send the Danish FSA statistics on the operation and misuse of their payment services every half year: by 1 April for the second half of the previous year and by 1 October for the first half of the current year. They use the FSA's electronic forms.
